title: Hussain ka muslim
body:
ghareeb hogaya kitna hussain ka muslim
hua hai kufe may tanha hussain ka muslim
<<DIVIDER>>
wo darbadar sar e kufa hai mil nahi sakte
paraya shehr hai jaa kar unhe kahan dhoondein
hai apne bachon se bichda hussain ka muslim
ghareeb hogaya kitna...
<<DIVIDER>>
kisi ne maare thay pathar kisi ke teer chale
to koi maar raha tha ghareeb ko naize
tab ek gaday may gira tha hussain ka muslim
ghareeb hogaya kitna...
<<DIVIDER>>
ay ibne ziyad zaban ko lagaam de apni
ameer hussain ka naukar hai ye tujhe to kabhi
salaam tak na karega hussain ka muslim
ghareeb hogaya kitna...
<<DIVIDER>>
layeen ne kaat ke sar chath se laasha phaynk diya
usay uthane ko jis dam koi nahi aaya
zameen pe zahra ne thaama hussain ka muslim
ghareeb hogaya kitna...
<<DIVIDER>>
ay maula bas wahin ruk jao tum abhi ho jahan
hai kufe waale dagha baaz tum na aana yahan
khabar ye de nahi paaya hussain ka muslim
ghareeb hogaya kitna...
<<DIVIDER>>
jab aaya khaafila kufe may ro padi farwa
jo dekha laasha e be-sar hai khoon aalooda
hai dar pe kufe ke latka hussain ka muslim
ghareeb hogaya kitna...
<<DIVIDER>>
liya jo jayega khoon e hussain ka badla
ay naqsh lashkar e qaim badhega jab kufa
to saath ghazi ke hoga hussain ka muslim
ghareeb hogaya kitna...
author: Naqsh Kazmi
